spans.s: बिल् r. 6th cl. (बिलति) r., 10th cl. (बेलयति-ते) To break, to tear or rend, to divide or detach.

बिल n. (-लं)
 1. A hole.
 2. A pit.
 3. An outlet.

बिल्ल n. (-ल्लं)
 1. A basin for water round the root of a tree.
 2. Asafœtida.

बिलेशय m. (यः)
 1. An animal that lives in holes.
 2. A snake.
 3. A
hare.
 4. A rat.

बिल्व m. (-ल्वः) A species of tree.
 n. (-ल्वं)
 1. The fruit of this tree.
 2. A
weight equal to one pala.
